Synapse 1.165.0, newer Element Web and Matrix Authentication Service, and security updates for the packages underneath.

## 🎨 Design

- The README groups its download buttons under titles and draws the section headings as chapter bands.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Synapse [v1.165.0](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.165.0)**, **Element Web [v1.12.35](https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/releases/tag/v1.12.35)** and **Matrix Authentication Service [1.29.0](https://github.com/element-hq/matrix-authentication-service/releases/tag/v1.29.0)**.
- **soupsieve 4.1.1 and tornado 6.6.1.** Synapse's image brings soupsieve 2.10 and tornado 6.5.9, both with open security advisories, and the image installs the fixed versions in their place. authlib is at 1.9.9 and joserfc at 1.8.0.
- **Debian security updates go in with every build.** The image upgrades the packages it inherits from Synapse's image, so fixes published after Synapse built its image are included too.
- **The newest release is rebuilt every week.** Every Sunday it is built again without the layer cache, so `latest` and the release's tags pick up security updates for the base image and its packages between releases.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Scanners see the libpq5 that is really installed.** The image already ran libpq5 17.12 from Debian's security updates, but Synapse's image keeps its own record of the old 17.11, and scanners reported 47 advisories against it. Once apt has installed or upgraded a library, the image drops that old record.
